add-alphanumeric-bates-numbering-to-pdf.title: Add Alphanumeric Bates Numbering To Pdf

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert Bates numbering stamps starting at 1000 with a dash separator on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages__v2.description: Loads a PDF document, applies year‑based Bates numbering (format "2026-####") to each page, and saves the updated file.

add-bates-numbering-with-custom-prefix-s.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, applying Bates numbering that includes a custom prefix and suffix, and saving the modified document.

add-bates-numbering-with-prefix.title: Add Bates Numbering with Alphanumeric Prefix to PDF
add-bates-numbering-with-prefix.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, apply Bates numbering with a custom alphanumeric prefix to every page, and save the updated document.

add-blank-front-matter-page-roman-label.title: Add Blank Front‑Matter Page with Roman Numeral Label
add-blank-front-matter-page-roman-label.description: Demonstrates how to insert a blank page at the beginning of an existing PDF and assign a custom page label using lowercase Roman numerals for front‑matter numbering.

add-blank-front-matter-page-with-label-i.title: Add Blank Front Matter Page With Label I

add-bold-uppercase-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Bold Uppercase Header to PDF Pages
add-bold-uppercase-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a bold, uppercase header on every page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-chapter-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Chapter Prefix Page Numbers to PDF
add-chapter-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert page numbers with a custom "Chapter" prefix on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf. The example sets alignment, margin, and text styling for the page number stamp.

add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-page.title: Add Curved Text Watermark To Pdf Page

add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Curved Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a repeated watermark that follows a curved arc across each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's WatermarkArtifact and TextState.

add-custom-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Page Numbers to PDF
add-custom-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a PageNumberStamp using the format "Page X of Y", apply it to every page, and save the updated document.

add-diagonal-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Diagonal Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-diagonal-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and apply a semi‑transparent diagonal text watermark using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

add-generation-date-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Generation Date Footer to Each PDF Page
add-generation-date-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add a text footer with the current generation date to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-logo-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Logo Image to PDF Pages
add-header-logo-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp for a company logo, align it to the top‑left of each page as a header, and save the modified document.

add-header-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Header Text to First PDF Page Using MarginInfo
add-header-to-first-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a text header to the first page of a PDF by configuring a HeaderFooter with MarginInfo and a TextFragment, then saving the document.

add-header-with-logo-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header With Logo To Pdf Pages

add-html-header-to-first-three-pdf-pages.title: Add HTML Header with CSS to First Three PDF Pages
add-html-header-to-first-three-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to embed a styled HTML header into the first three pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then convert the document to HTML while preserving the header.

add-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Footer with Opacity to PDF Pages
add-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image footer with 30% opacity to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-footer-with-scaling-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Image Footer with Scaling to PDF Pages
add-image-footer-with-scaling-to-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to insert a scaled footer image on every page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-watermark-with-opacity-to-pdf-.title: Add Image Watermark with Opacity to PDF Pages
add-image-watermark-with-opacity-to-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent image (logo) on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, creating a subtle branding watermark.

add-lightgray-background-to-pdf-pages.title: Add LightGray Background to PDF Pages
add-lightgray-background-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over each page, set a LightGray background color for consistent branding, and save the modified document.

add-multiple-empty-pages-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Empty Pages Sequentially to PDF
add-multiple-empty-pages-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a series of empty pages to a PDF by iterating over a list of page counts, with handling for Aspose.PDF evaluation limits.

add-page-numbers-to-even-pdf-pages.title: Add Page Numbers to Even PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-even-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages, and adding a page number stamp only to even-numbered pages before saving the result.

add-page-numbers-to-odd-pdf-pages.title: Add Page Numbers to Odd PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-odd-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages, and applying a page number stamp only to odd-numbered pages before saving the document.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a centered page number stamp starting at 1 on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-numbers-with-custom-embedded-fo.title: Add Page Numbers with Custom Embedded Font to PDF
add-page-numbers-with-custom-embedded-fo.description: Demonstrates how to insert page numbers on every PDF page using a TrueType font loaded from an external file and embed that font in the resulting document.

add-page-numbers-with-custom-font.title: Add Page Numbers With Custom Font

add-repeating-image-watermark-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Repeating Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-repeating-image-watermark-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent image repeatedly in a grid pattern on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-roman-numeral-page-numbers.title: Add Roman Numeral Page Numbers to Introductory PDF Pages
add-roman-numeral-page-numbers.description: Demonstrates how to insert page numbers in uppercase Roman numeral format on the first few pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-rotated-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a 45‑degree rotated, half‑size image as a watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-scaled-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Scaled Image Footer To Pdf Pages

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark with Outline to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and apply a semi‑transparent text watermark with an outline using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

add-superscript-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Superscript Page Numbers to PDF Pages
add-superscript-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert page numbers with a superscript‑style appearance on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PageNumberStamp.

add-year-text-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Year-Based Text Watermark to PDF
add-year-text-watermark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextStamp that includes the current year, apply it to every page, and save the watermarked document.

adjust-media-box-to-crop-pdf-page.title: Adjust Media Box To Crop Pdf Page

adjust-pdf-bleedbox-for-printer-specs.title: Adjust PDF BleedBox for Printer Specifications
adjust-pdf-bleedbox-for-printer-specs.description: Shows how to read each page's BleedBox, expand it by a margin, and save the modified PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

append-empty-a4-page-to-pdf.title: Append Empty A4 Page to PDF
append-empty-a4-page-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, adding a blank A4‑sized page at the end of the document, and saving the modified file.

append-page-to-pdf.title: Append a Page from One PDF to Another
append-page-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates copying a specific page from a source PDF and appending it to the end of a target PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.title: Batch Add Bates Numbering to PDF Pages
batch-add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a folder, adds sequential Bates numbers starting at 5 with six‑digit zero padding, and saves the modified PDFs to an output directory.

batch-resize-pdf-pages-fixed-width.title: Batch Resize PDF Pages to Fixed Width
batch-resize-pdf-pages-fixed-width.description: Shows how to resize every page in a PDF to a target width of 800 points while preserving the original aspect ratio using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-odd-pages-landscape-to-portrait.title: Convert Odd Pages from Landscape to Portrait
convert-odd-pages-landscape-to-portrait.description: Shows how to change the orientation of odd‑numbered PDF pages from landscape to portrait by swapping the MediaBox dimensions and updating the PageInfo flag using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-pages-portrait-to-landscape.title: Convert PDF Pages from Portrait to Landscape
convert-pdf-pages-portrait-to-landscape.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, swaps the MediaBox width and height using SetPageSize to change the orientation to landscape, and saves the modified document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-portrait.title: Convert PDF Pages to Portrait Orientation
convert-pdf-pages-to-portrait.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and changes any landscape page to portrait by swapping the MediaBox dimensions, then saves the modified document.

copy-mediabox-page-8-to-12.title: Copy MediaBox from Page 8 to Page 12
copy-mediabox-page-8-to-12.description: Demonstrates how to read the MediaBox rectangle from one PDF page and apply it to another page using Aspose.Pdf, ensuring both pages share the same dimensions.

crop-pdf-page-media-box.title: Crop PDF Page by Setting MediaBox
crop-pdf-page-media-box.description: Shows how to define a custom cropping region for a PDF page by setting its MediaBox, leaving the page content unchanged.

crop-pdf-pages-remove-margins.title: Crop PDF Pages to Remove Margins
crop-pdf-pages-remove-margins.description: Demonstrates how to adjust the CropBox of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf to trim specified left, right, top, and bottom margins.

crop-pdf-pages-to-4-3-aspect-ratio.title: Crop PDF Pages to 4:3 Aspect Ratio for Slides
crop-pdf-pages-to-4-3-aspect-ratio.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and set a centered CropBox so each page conforms to a 4:3 aspect ratio suitable for presentation slides.

crop-pdf-pages-to-4by3-aspect-ratio.title: Crop Pdf Pages To 4By3 Aspect Ratio

delete-first-page-from-pdf.title: Delete First Page from PDF and Shift Remaining Pages
delete-first-page-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, remove the first page, and save the document so that the remaining pages automatically shift forward.

delete-last-page-from-pdfs.title: Delete Last Page from PDFs in a Folder
delete-last-page-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files in a directory, removing the last page of each document with Aspose.Pdf, and overwriting the original files.

delete-last-three-pages-from-pdf.title: Delete Last Three Pages from PDF
delete-last-three-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify it has at least three pages, delete the last three pages using PageCollection.Delete, and save the modified document.

delete-page-range-from-pdf.title: Delete Page Range from PDF
delete-page-range-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove pages 5 through 10 from a PDF document in a single operation using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pdf-pages-from-config.title: Delete PDF Pages Using a Config File
delete-pdf-pages-from-config.description: Shows how to read page numbers from a text configuration file and delete those pages from a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

delete-specified-pdf-pages.title: Delete Specified PDF Pages Using Aspose.Pdf
delete-specified-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to read a list of page numbers from a text file and delete those pages from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

duplicate-third-page-in-pdf.title: Duplicate Third Page in PDF
duplicate-third-page-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to duplicate the third page of a PDF document and insert the copy immediately after the original using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-page-dimensions-to-csv.title: Export PDF Page Dimensions to CSV
export-pdf-page-dimensions-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF document, reads the width and height of each page, and writes the page number with its dimensions to a CSV file for external analysis.

extend-bleedbox-beyond-cropbox.title: Extend BleedBox Beyond CropBox in PDF
extend-bleedbox-beyond-cropbox.description: Demonstrates how to increase each page's BleedBox by 5 points on all sides relative to the existing CropBox using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-resize-reinsert-pdf-pages.title: Extract, Resize, and Reinsert PDF Pages
extract-resize-reinsert-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to extract a range of pages from a PDF, change their size to A4, and insert them at a new position using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-blank-page-at-index-three.title: Insert Blank Page at Specific Position in PDF
insert-blank-page-at-index-three.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, insert a blank page at position 3 using the Pages.Insert method, and save the updated document.

insert-blank-pages-after-each-page.title: Insert Blank Pages After Each Page in PDF
insert-blank-pages-after-each-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate its pages in reverse, and insert a blank page after each existing page, effectively doubling the page count.

insert-custom-page-numbers-pdf.title: Insert Custom Page Numbers (current/total) into PDF
insert-custom-page-numbers-pdf.description: Shows how to add page numbers in the "current/total" format to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with the numbers placed at the bottom‑right corner.

insert-custom-sized-page-at-beginning.title: Insert Custom-Sized Page at Beginning of PDF
insert-custom-sized-page-at-beginning.description: Demonstrates how to insert an empty page with a custom size of 200 × 300 points at the start of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-empty-page-with-custom-size.title: Insert Empty Page with Custom Size into PDF
insert-empty-page-with-custom-size.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, add an empty page, set its width and height from user input, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-external-pdf-page-at-index.title: Insert External Pdf Page At Index

insert-page-from-another-pdf.title: Insert Page from Another PDF at Specific Position
insert-page-from-another-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF documents, take a page from the source PDF, and insert it into the target PDF at index two while keeping the original size and rotation.

insert-page-matching-page2-size.title: Insert New Page Matching Page 2 Size
insert-page-matching-page2-size.description: Demonstrates how to copy the width and height of page 2 in a PDF and insert a new empty page at position 5 with the same dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-page-numbers-after-toc.title: Insert Page Numbers After Table of Contents Using Bookmark Detection
insert-page-numbers-after-toc.description: Demonstrates how to locate the Table of Contents bookmark in a PDF, determine its page, and add sequential page numbers to all subsequent pages using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-page-numbers-arial-font.title: Insert Page Numbers with Arial Font in PDF
insert-page-numbers-arial-font.description: Demonstrates how to add sequential page numbers to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, customizing the font to Arial and size to 14 points.

insert-page-numbers-leading-zeros.title: Insert Page Numbers with Leading Zeros in PDF
insert-page-numbers-leading-zeros.description: Demonstrates how to add page numbers to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, formatting single‑digit numbers with a leading zero (e.g., 01, 02). The example positions the stamp at the bottom‑center and customizes its appearance.

insert-ten-empty-pages-at-pdf-midpoint.title: Insert Ten Empty Pages at PDF Midpoint
insert-ten-empty-pages-at-pdf-midpoint.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, calculate its middle page, and batch‑insert ten blank pages at that position.

insert-transparent-separator-page.title: Insert Transparent Separator Page into PDF
insert-transparent-separator-page.description: Shows how to add an empty page with a transparent background as a separator between sections of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

move-even-pages-to-end.title: Move Even Pages to End of PDF
move-even-pages-to-end.description: Demonstrates how to reorder a PDF by extracting all even‑numbered pages and appending them to the end while preserving their original order using Aspose.Pdf.

move-page-9-to-first-position.title: Move Page 9 to First Position in PDF
move-page-9-to-first-position.description: Shows how to reposition page 9 to the beginning of a PDF by inserting it at index 1 and removing the original occurrence using Aspose.Pdf.

move-page-between-pdfs-preserving-rotati.title: Move Page Between Pdfs Preserving Rotation Size

move-pdf-page-to-another-document.title: Move a PDF Page to Another Document
move-pdf-page-to-another-document.description: Demonstrates how to transfer a single page from a source PDF to a destination PDF while preserving its original rotation and size, then saves both modified documents.

move-pdf-pages-to-end.title: Move Specific PDF Pages to End
move-pdf-pages-to-end.description: Shows how to extract pages 3‑6 from a PDF and relocate them to the end of the document using Aspose.Pdf.

read-pdf-page-count.title: Read PDF Page Count with Aspose.Pdf
read-pdf-page-count.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and retrieve the total number of pages without modifying the file.

read-pdf-page-dimensions.title: Read PDF Page Dimensions
read-pdf-page-dimensions.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates over each page, and logs the width and height of the page rectangle to the console.

read-pdf-page-dimensions__v2.title: Read PDF Page Width and Height
read-pdf-page-dimensions__v2.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and retrieve each page's width and height using the page rectangle.

remove-bates-numbering-add-new-sequence.title: Remove Existing Bates Numbering and Add New Sequence to PDF
remove-bates-numbering-add-new-sequence.description: Shows how to delete all Bates numbering artifacts from a PDF and then apply a new Bates numbering sequence using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-bates-numbering-from-selected-pdf.title: Remove Bates Numbering from Selected PDF Pages
remove-bates-numbering-from-selected-pdf.description: Shows how to delete all Bates numbering artifacts from a PDF and then re‑add them only to pages that should keep the stamp, effectively removing the numbering from specific pages.

reorder-pdf-pages-by-orientation.title: Reorder PDF Pages by Orientation
reorder-pdf-pages-by-orientation.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, separate landscape and portrait pages, and rebuild the document so that all landscape pages appear before portrait pages.

reorder-pdf-pages-custom-sequence.title: Reorder PDF Pages Using Custom Sequence
reorder-pdf-pages-custom-sequence.description: Shows how to reorder the pages of a PDF by providing a custom integer array that defines the new page order and saving the result with Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-pages-descending.title: Reorder PDF Pages in Descending Order
reorder-pdf-pages-descending.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, copy its pages in reverse (descending) order into a new document, optionally balance the page tree, and save the reordered file.

replace-pdf-headers-footers.title: Replace PDF Headers and Footers
replace-pdf-headers-footers.description: Demonstrates how to remove existing headers and footers from all pages of a PDF and add new styled header and footer content, including page numbers, using Aspose.Pdf.

reset-page-rotation.title: Reset Page Rotation in PDF
reset-page-rotation.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read a page's current rotation, reset it to no rotation, and save the updated document.

resize-pdf-page-to-letter-size.title: Resize PDF Page to Letter Size
resize-pdf-page-to-letter-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify it has at least seven pages, and change page 7 to the Letter format using SetPageSize, then save the document.

resize-pdf-pages-to-a5.title: Resize PDF Pages to A5 Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-a5.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages, resizes each page to A5 dimensions, and saves the modified document.

resize-pdf-pages-to-match-template-size.title: Resize Pdf Pages To Match Template Size

resize-pdf-pages-to-printable-area.title: Resize PDF Pages to Printable Area
resize-pdf-pages-to-printable-area.description: Shows how to resize every page of a PDF to a fixed printable size of 595 × 842 points, scaling the existing content proportionally using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Match Template Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size.description: Shows how to read the dimensions of a template PDF's first page and apply those dimensions to every page of another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size__v2.title: Resize PDF Pages to Match Template Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a reference PDF, extract its page dimensions, and resize all pages of another PDF to those dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-uniform-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Uniform Size
resize-pdf-pages-uniform-size.description: Shows how to determine the largest page dimensions in a PDF and resize every page to those dimensions, creating a uniform page size throughout the document.

resize-wide-pdf-pages-to-a4.title: Resize Wide PDF Pages to A4
resize-wide-pdf-pages-to-a4.description: Loads a PDF, checks each page's width, and sets the page size to A4 for pages wider than 600 points while leaving narrower pages unchanged.

retrieve-trimbox-after-cropping-pdf-page.title: Retrieve TrimBox After Cropping a PDF Page
retrieve-trimbox-after-cropping-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to set a CropBox on a PDF page and then read the resulting TrimBox to verify the content area using Aspose.Pdf.

retrieve-trimbox-values-from-pdf-pages.title: Retrieve Trimbox Values From Pdf Pages

rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.title: Rotate All PDF Pages 180 Degrees
rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each page 180° using the Rotate property, and save the modified document.

rotate-every-third-pdf-page-90-degrees.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page by 90 Degrees
rotate-every-third-pdf-page-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, rotate pages whose number is divisible by three by 90°, and save the modified document.

rotate-fourth-page-90-degrees-clockwise.title: Rotate Fourth Page 90 Degrees Clockwise
rotate-fourth-page-90-degrees-clockwise.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify it has at least four pages, rotate page 4 by 90° clockwise using the Rotate property, and save the modified document.

rotate-pdf-pages-by-parity.title: Rotate PDF Pages Based on Page Number Parity
rotate-pdf-pages-by-parity.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, apply a 90° clockwise rotation to odd‑numbered pages while leaving even pages unchanged, and save the modified document.

rotate-pdf-pages-reverse-order.title: Rotate PDF Pages in Reverse Order
rotate-pdf-pages-reverse-order.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages in reverse order, applies a 90° clockwise rotation to each page, and saves the modified document.

rotate-pdf-pages-using-config.title: Rotate PDF Pages Using Configuration Dictionary
rotate-pdf-pages-using-config.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate selected pages based on a dictionary of page numbers to angles, and save the modified document.

set-alternating-page-background-colors.title: Set Alternating Page Background Colors in PDF
set-alternating-page-background-colors.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and assign LightGray or White background colors alternately before saving the document.

set-custom-size-first-pdf-page.title: Set Custom Size for First PDF Page
set-custom-size-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, change the first page size to 500 × 700 points, and save the modified document.

set-page-background-color-hsl.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using HSL Values
set-page-background-color-hsl.description: Demonstrates converting HSL color values to an Aspose.Pdf.Color and applying the resulting color as the background of a PDF page.

set-pdf-page-background-cmyk.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using CMYK Values
set-pdf-page-background-cmyk.description: Shows how to apply a CMYK background color to every page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating a simple source PDF if it does not exist.

set-pdf-page-background-color-from-theme.title: Set PDF Page Background Color from Theme Configuration
set-pdf-page-background-color-from-theme.description: Shows how to read a theme value from a JSON configuration file and apply the corresponding background color to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-background-color.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using RGB
set-pdf-page-background-color.description: Demonstrates how to apply a corporate brand RGB background color to every page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-background-from-theme.title: Set Pdf Page Background From Theme

set-transparent-background-for-pdf-pages.title: Set Transparent Background for PDF Pages
set-transparent-background-for-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to make each page and the entire PDF document background transparent using Aspose.Pdf.

trim-white-margins-pixel-tolerance.title: Trim White Margins with Pixel Tolerance per PDF Page
trim-white-margins-pixel-tolerance.description: Demonstrates how to remove blank pages and trim white margins of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, applying a custom pixel‑tolerance for each page.

trim-white-space-from-pdf-pages.title: Trim White Space from PDF Pages
trim-white-space-from-pdf-pages.description: The example loads a PDF, skips blank pages, calculates the content bounding box for each page, sets the TrimBox to that rectangle to remove surrounding whitespace, and saves the trimmed document.
